**Finding [high, correctness] — byte-for-byte preservation:** Reworked the managed-file plan/apply path to operate entirely in the byte domain. Added a byte-twin regex `_BLOCK_RE_BYTES` plus `_find_block_bytes`/`_block_is_fresh_bytes`/`_append_block_bytes`/`_replace_block_bytes`; `_plan_managed_file` now `read_bytes()` existing files and splices the encoded block, `FileAction.new_content` is now `bytes`, and `apply_onboarding` writes via `write_bytes()`. Existing content outside the markers is never decoded/re-encoded, so CRLF endings, missing trailing newlines, and non-UTF-8 prose all survive verbatim. The ASCII markers locate unambiguously regardless of surrounding encoding. Added three tests: CRLF preservation, non-UTF-8 bytes outside markers, and stale-block replace preserving surrounding CRLF bytes.
